macro_and_money.fact: Xuzhou awarded RMB 2.197m for third-party acceptance covering the city's SME digital-transformation trial; acceptance uses document review, on-site verification, personnel interviews and effectiveness determination through the trial completion window.
Two digital-level assessment packages were awarded in August 2026 and require objective assessment reports.
A third assessment package covers 189 pilot enterprises and had a 2026-09-16 bid deadline, confirming the assessment/acceptance window is current rather than historical.

psychology_and_behavior.fact: Existing aggregate evidence tracks value-for-money, spending caution, trust/risk aversion, outcome certainty and rapidly rising AI normalization; social-platform salience is explicitly not treated as population share.
Existing cycle evidence uses lower-tier digital adoption and consumer behavior only as aggregate/segment signals, not individual demand proof.

local_provider_nodes.fact: Jiangsu Caizi Network Technology states it entered Xuzhou's first-batch SME digital-transformation service-provider pool and has two small/fast/light/precise solutions in the city list.
Jiangsu Pengcheng Carbon Asset Operation, a Xuzhou state-owned platform company, states it entered the first-batch provider pool and publicly names a provider contact.
The Huaihai Private Enterprise Digital Transformation Research Institute is a nonprofit local trust/access node whose member network includes digital-service and industrial firms.

young_ai_execution_nodes.fact: Xuzhou Institute of Technology held a 2026 AI-era employment/entrepreneurship OPC program with more than 300 students and an AI startup-community/resource path, indicating a local pool of actors building AI execution capability.
A separate 2026 OPC entrepreneurship camp selected 40 students for structured practical training.

counterevidence.fact: Xuzhou already procured a RMB 5.819m specialist think-tank support contract covering planning, standards, operation and performance evaluation, so generic coordination/consulting is already institutionalized.
Local providers already advertise end-to-end consulting, planning, implementation, development and operations, so a generic digital-transformation middleman has no demonstrated incremental value.
The local digital-transformation institute already convenes university and industry experts, so expert matching alone is not novel.

formations.name: Acceptance-bounded industrial micro-cell: domain judgment + AI execution + controller-approved settlement
formations.origin_actor: A first-batch digital-transformation provider or pilot SME with a real, current, bounded project blocker before assessment/acceptance.
objective_endowment: A filed/contracted digital-transformation project and an existing implementation team
A concrete assessment/acceptance regime with observable evidence requirements
Potential access to enterprise process/system context under controller permission
A current deadline that can make small edge tasks disproportionately costly to staff internally
formations.state_change: The citywide pilot is moving from diagnosis/implementation into assessment, audit, acceptance and subsidy settlement, converting vague transformation work into time-bounded evidence and outcome obligations.
formations.perception_motive_hypothesis: Primary providers and enterprise controllers may value outcome certainty and deadline-risk reduction more than adding permanent headcount for every small specialist gap. This is an inference until a live blocker is returned.
formations.observed_behavior: The city has procured assessment and acceptance institutions; providers are actively delivering full-chain transformation work; local providers publish AI/digital implementation activity and the pilot operates under repeated evaluation/acceptance milestones.
formations.resource_psychology_disequilibrium: A provider can possess the client relationship, project, systems and broad implementation capability while still rationally declining to internalize every narrow edge capability; separately, senior domain judgment and young AI execution capacity can exist without a trusted, acceptance-bounded call path.
formations.unformed_outcome: A controller-approved way to convert one narrow acceptance-critical gap into a small, auditable, quickly assembled task cell without buying a permanent employee, a generic consultant or an entire new solution stack.

complementary_nodes.node: primary digital-transformation provider or pilot enterprise
complementary_nodes.contribution: task authority, project truth, permission, acceptance and settlement

complementary_nodes.node: authorized industry expert / senior engineer / qualified specialist
complementary_nodes.contribution: process context, failure modes, industrial constraints and domain QA
complementary_nodes.note: retired status is optional; the resource is callable judgment, not age

complementary_nodes.node: young/local AI or software executor with demonstrated capability
complementary_nodes.contribution: bounded automation, data/evidence processing, interface, prototype or implementation work

complementary_nodes.node: controller-defined acceptance owner and relevant assessment evidence

complementary_nodes.contribution: truth packet, role boundaries, permission, node optioning, interface design, risk, attribution and settlement governance

formations.counterfactual_exchange: Instead of asking one service provider to permanently own every specialist capability or asking a senior expert/young executor to sell generic labor, form a temporary micro-cell around one already-authorized live blocker: controller supplies truth/permission, domain node constrains the solution, execution node produces the bounded artifact, acceptance owner verifies it, and orchestrator is paid only if composition reduces risk/time/cost beyond internal handling.
why_it_may_not_already_happen: Small tasks may be too context-heavy for ordinary freelancer marketplaces and too small for specialist firms' sales processes.
Young executors may lack industrial context/trust while senior experts may lack rapid digital execution capacity.
The controller may have no standard way to expose a redacted blocker, authorize external nodes, define acceptance and attribute economics.
material_counterevidence: Full-chain providers may already solve all such tasks internally more cheaply.
Existing expert pools, university-industry matching and internships mean neither expert matching nor youth projects alone is new.
If the structure is merely staffing/body-shopping, it violates the orchestration thesis and has weak defensibility.
Enterprise data, cybersecurity, IP or confidentiality may make external composition uneconomic or impermissible.
formations.cheapest_decisive_validation: Obtain exactly one redacted live blocker from a legitimate first-batch provider/controller. Require current project scope, controller, deadline, acceptance evidence, confidentiality/data boundary, explicit reason the internal team will not efficiently solve it, permission for an external specialist, and a real fee/subcontract/referral/settlement path. Only after this packet exists, option one domain node and one execution node for the exact task and ask the controller to approve the composition before any work.
formations.promotion_gate: LIVE_BLOCKER + CONTROLLER_PERMISSION + DOMAIN_NODE_OPTIONED + EXECUTION_NODE_OPTIONED + ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_DEFINED + FEE_OR_SETTLEMENT_PATH
kill_conditions: provider can solve internally at lower total coordination cost
no lawful redacted task packet can be shared
external specialists are contractually or operationally prohibited
domain plus execution composition does not reduce time/risk/cost
route collapses into generic staffing or contact brokerage

formations.name: Older-adult AI self-efficacy + young digital teaching + trusted local context
formations.resource_psychology_disequilibrium: Some older adults have time, willingness to remain digitally connected and growing AI curiosity while tool change, information filtering and trust can exceed their self-service capacity; young actors may have digital fluency but weak paid access/trust.
formations.counterfactual_exchange: A trusted institution/community could compose bounded one-to-one or small-group outcome-based AI help rather than generic software training.
formations.counterevidence: Public/free university, community and volunteer digital-help programs are common enough that private payer/repeat economics are unknown.
formations.why_not_selected_now: Requires more current local behavior/payment evidence and has weaker immediate acceptance/settlement boundaries than the industrial pilot.

formations.name: Experienced industrial judgment as a bounded callable node
formations.resource_psychology_disequilibrium: Experienced technical actors may retain valuable judgment while preferring flexible contribution over full-time employment; SMEs can face short judgment gaps they cannot justify staffing permanently.
formations.counterfactual_exchange: Package a narrow decision/review/diagnosis unit with evidence, rights and acceptance rather than creating a generic retired-expert marketplace.
formations.counterevidence: Xuzhou/Jiangsu already have expert pools and university-industry mechanisms; simple expert matching is already supplied.
formations.why_not_selected_now: Use as a possible DOMAIN_JUDGMENT node inside the primary formation until a repeated micro-advisory format is proven.

formations.name: Young AI execution capacity + real bounded industrial work
formations.resource_psychology_disequilibrium: Young actors can build AI/software capability and seek real-world proof while lacking enterprise trust, industrial context and acceptance authority.
formations.counterfactual_exchange: Expose only controller-approved bounded tasks with domain guardrails and explicit acceptance rather than selling untrusted generic freelancer hours.
formations.counterevidence: Internships, university-enterprise cooperation and OPC programs already provide practice routes; enterprise liability and QA remain material.
formations.why_not_selected_now: Treat as an execution-supply node in the primary formation, not a standalone business thesis.

selection.selection_method: NO_SYNTHETIC_SCORE; selected because it overlays an already-current acceptance window, has heterogeneous observable nodes, can be killed with one real controller packet, and keeps the founder in orchestration rather than delivery.
not_claimed: No demand is inferred from psychology alone.
No service provider is claimed to have an uncovered blocker yet.
No retired expert or young executor is claimed to be optioned.
No payer, fee or margin is claimed until controller evidence exists.
No outreach was sent in this cycle.
selection.exact_next_truth: ONE_LAWFUL_REDACTED_LIVE_BLOCKER + CONTROLLER_PERMISSION + DEADLINE + ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE + EXTERNAL_NODE_PERMISSION + ECONOMIC_PATH
